<script id="fc-v1282-modern-pull-refresh-js">
(function(){
'use strict';
const ARM_RAW=72,HOLD=34,MAX_PULL=52;
const ptr={startY:0,startX:0,eligible:false,pulling:false,armed:false,refreshing:false,surface:null};
function ui(){let el=document.getElementById('fcPullRefreshV1282');if(el)return el;el=document.createElement('div');el.id='fcPullRefreshV1282';el.setAttribute('role','status');el.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');el.setAttribute('aria-label','Pull to refresh');el.innerHTML='<div class="fc-ptr-ring-v1282" aria-hidden="true"><span class="fc-ptr-glyph-v1282">↓</span></div>';document.body.appendChild(el);return el}
function label(text,glyph){const el=ui(),g=el.querySelector('.fc-ptr-glyph-v1282');el.setAttribute('aria-label',text);if(g&&glyph!=null)g.textContent=glyph}
function haptic(){try{if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(8)}catch(_){}}
function atTop(){const root=document.scrollingElement||document.documentElement;return(window.scrollY||root.scrollTop||0)<=1}
function surface(){const map={feed:'feedView',challenges:'challengesViewSection',leaderboard:'leaderboardViewSection',polls:'pollsViewSection'},id=map[state.currentView],el=id?document.getElementById(id):null;return el&&getComputedStyle(el).display!=='none'?el:null}
function blocked(t){if(!t)return true;if(t.closest('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"],.fc-audio-seek-v1123'))return true;return!!document.querySelector('.modal-backdrop.show,.modal-backdrop.open,.cc-sheet.open,.cd-sheet.open,.entry-viewer.open,.entrants-sheet.open,.ember-assistant-sheet.open,.user-profile-modal.open')}
function setY(y){if(!ptr.surface)return;ptr.surface.classList.add('fc-ptr-surface-v1282');ptr.surface.style.setProperty('--fc-ptr-y-v1282',Math.max(0,y).toFixed(1)+'px')}
function setProgress(p){const el=ui(),v=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p));el.style.setProperty('--fc-ptr-deg-v1282',(v*360).toFixed(0)+'deg');el.style.setProperty('--fc-ptr-arrow-v1282',(v*180).toFixed(0)+'deg')}
function clearBody(){document.body.classList.remove('fc-ptr-visible-v1282','fc-ptr-armed-v1282','fc-ptr-refreshing-v1282','fc-ptr-done-v1282','fc-ptr-error-v1282','fc-ptr-releasing-v1282')}
function reset(){if(ptr.surface){ptr.surface.style.removeProperty('--fc-ptr-y-v1282');ptr.surface.classList.remove('fc-ptr-surface-v1282')}ptr.surface=null;ptr.eligible=false;ptr.pulling=false;ptr.armed=false;setProgress(0)}
function release(){if(!ptr.pulling){reset();return}document.body.classList.remove('fc-ptr-armed-v1282');document.body.classList.add('fc-ptr-releasing-v1282');setY(0);setTimeout(()=>{clearBody();reset();label('Pull to refresh','↓')},330)}
async function refreshView(){const v=state.currentView;if(v==='feed'){await Promise.all([typeof loadChallenges==='function'?loadChallenges({throwOnError:true}):Promise.resolve(),typeof loadFeedActivity==='function'?loadFeedActivity({throwOnError:true}):Promise.resolve(),typeof loadPosts==='function'?loadPosts():Promise.resolve()]);if(typeof renderFeedHello==='function')renderFeedHello();if(typeof renderHeatCheck==='function')renderHeatCheck();if(typeof renderFeed==='function')renderFeed();if(typeof wireWinnerReveals==='function')requestAnimationFrame(()=>setTimeout(()=>wireWinnerReveals(),80));return}if(v==='challenges'){await Promise.all([typeof loadChallenges==='function'?loadChallenges({throwOnError:true}):Promise.resolve(),typeof loadFeedActivity==='function'?loadFeedActivity({throwOnError:true}):Promise.resolve()]);if(typeof renderChallenges==='function')renderChallenges();return}if(v==='leaderboard'){await Promise.all([typeof loadChampionshipData==='function'?loadChampionshipData():Promise.resolve(),typeof loadLeaderboard==='function'?loadLeaderboard():Promise.resolve(),typeof loadMyRecord==='function'?loadMyRecord():Promise.resolve()]);state._leaderboardStale=false;if(typeof renderLeaderboard==='function')renderLeaderboard();if(typeof buildTicker==='function')buildTicker();return}if(v==='polls'){if(typeof liveTick==='function')await liveTick();if(typeof renderPolls==='function')renderPolls()}}
async function perform(){if(ptr.refreshing)return;ptr.refreshing=true;document.body.classList.remove('fc-ptr-armed-v1282','fc-ptr-releasing-v1282');document.body.classList.add('fc-ptr-visible-v1282','fc-ptr-refreshing-v1282');label('Refreshing');setY(HOLD);try{await refreshView();document.body.classList.remove('fc-ptr-refreshing-v1282');document.body.classList.add('fc-ptr-done-v1282');label('Updated','✓');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,460))}catch(e){console.error('[v1282] pull refresh failed',e);document.body.classList.remove('fc-ptr-refreshing-v1282');document.body.classList.add('fc-ptr-error-v1282');label('Could not refresh','!');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,560))}finally{document.body.classList.add('fc-ptr-releasing-v1282');setY(0);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,310));ptr.refreshing=false;clearBody();reset();label('Pull to refresh','↓')}}
function start(e){if(ptr.refreshing||e.touches?.length!==1||!atTop()||blocked(e.target))return;const s=surface();if(!s)return;const t=e.touches[0];ptr.startY=t.clientY;ptr.startX=t.clientX;ptr.surface=s;ptr.eligible=true;ptr.pulling=false;ptr.armed=false}
function move(e){if(!ptr.eligible||ptr.refreshing||e.touches?.length!==1)return;const t=e.touches[0],dy=t.clientY-ptr.startY,dx=t.clientX-ptr.startX;if(dy<=0){if(ptr.pulling)release();else reset();return}if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*.85&&Math.abs(dx)>10){reset();return}if(!atTop()&&!ptr.pulling){reset();return}if(dy<5)return;if(e.cancelable)e.preventDefault();ptr.pulling=true;const progress=Math.min(1,dy/ARM_RAW),visual=Math.min(MAX_PULL,dy*.56),armed=dy>=ARM_RAW;setProgress(progress);if(armed!==ptr.armed){ptr.armed=armed;document.body.classList.toggle('fc-ptr-armed-v1282',armed);if(armed){label('Release to refresh','↑');haptic()}else label('Pull to refresh','↓')}document.body.classList.add('fc-ptr-visible-v1282');setY(visual)}
function end(){if(ptr.refreshing)return;if(!ptr.eligible&&!ptr.pulling)return;if(ptr.pulling&&ptr.armed)perform();else release()}
ui();document.addEventListener('touchstart',start,{passive:true});document.addEventListener('touchmove',move,{passive:false});document.addEventListener('touchend',end,{passive:true});document.addEventListener('touchcancel',()=>{if(!ptr.refreshing)release()},{passive:true});
window.FC_V1282_VALIDATION={build:'v1282',compactIndicator:true,maxPageTravel52:true,progressRing:true,spinner:true,briefCheck:true,thresholdHapticWhereSupported:true,feedRefresh:true,competeRefresh:true,titlesRefresh:true};
})();
</script>
